reason: My office help already takes the calls during the day, and I have more work than my crews can handle. Paying 990 plus 149 a month so I can get even more enquiries doesn't fix a problem I actually have.
objection: I don't need more enquiries, I need people to do the jobs. And it's a brand-new company with no customers, so if it breaks or they fold, my customers end up getting odd WhatsApp messages in my name.
would_change_my_mind: If it sorted out the enquiries so we could turn away the small stuff and pick the bigger, better jobs, and a fellow Handwerker I know had used it for a few months without trouble.
